source_behavior.summary: GlobalCommentsWorkspace renders a localized Manage anchor for loaded comment rows. Its target is /sites/{SelectedSiteId}/comments, so every row navigates to the Comments Manager for the currently selected authoritative site.
source_behavior.selected_site_source: SelectedSiteId is parsed from the workspace-selected site state populated from SiteWebService.GetSitesAsync().
source_behavior.success_semantics: navigation only; the source control does not mutate WordPress, local persistence, queues, caches, schedules, providers, or secrets

laravel_adaptation.runtime_wiring: CommentsManageSiteControl is mounted only by RouteElement for route.key === 'comments' on the real tenant Comments workspace.
laravel_adaptation.placement_adaptation: The source repeats the same selected-site Manage destination in each result row. Laravel exposes one workspace-level Manage action because the destination is invariant for all rows; no row identity participates in the source target.
laravel_adaptation.destination_derivation: tenant slug, active_site.id, and api.comments must agree in the server-authoritative FrontendContext before the link renders

runtime_path: authenticated request enters /tenants/{tenant}/module/comments with tenant.context active
frontend context requires tenant.view and resolves the optional site query through tenant-scoped Site::query()->findOrFail
only a successfully resolved tenant-owned site is returned as active_site and receives a matching api.comments contract
the control requires tenant.view plus the existing Comments route capability, which preserves content.view and comments.read connector scope
the control verifies api.comments is same-origin and exactly matches the active tenant/site before deriving the destination
the destination uses tenantUrl with the authoritative tenant slug and active site id
the existing /tenants/{tenant}/sites/{site}/comments route re-authorizes content.view, resolves the Site under TenantContext, and redirects to the real Comments workspace with the site query
navigation performs no mutation and reports no fabricated success state

authorization.frontend_capability: resolveCapability for the canonical comments route additionally requires the advertised comments.read connector scope

tenant_isolation.active_site_resolution: server-side tenant-scoped Site::query()->findOrFail on the context request

runtime_semantics.csrf_write_path: not applicable; no write request is issued
runtime_semantics.persistence: no Site or Comment persistence change
runtime_semantics.authoritative_reread: destination route re-enters the server tenant/site resolver and the Comments workspace reloads its server context
runtime_semantics.truthful_success: no success state exists; missing or inconsistent authority removes the link
runtime_semantics.secret_exposure: none; the control consumes only tenant slug, numeric site id, permissions/capability metadata, and same-origin API path
runtime_semantics.wordpress_connector_safety: no WordPress mutation or Connector call is performed by the control
runtime_semantics.ai_provider_safety: not applicable; no AI/provider call is performed
runtime_semantics.audit_or_receipt: not applicable because no domain mutation occurs

proof: exact canonical operation marker and localized Manage anchor
foreign tenant, foreign site, foreign origin, query and fragment overrides fail closed
tenant.view, content.view, comments.read and explicit disabled capability boundaries fail closed
destination route keeps auth + tenant.context + content.view
guest, missing permission, foreign tenant and foreign direct-site access fail closed
authorized navigation leaves authoritative Site persistence unchanged
no API mutation, CSRF write, queue/cache/scheduler, secret, WordPress mutation, Connector mutation or provider call

terminality.reason: The source selected-site Manage navigation is implemented on the real Laravel Comments workspace using only mutually consistent server-authoritative tenant/site/API context, existing RBAC/connector capability boundaries, and the existing tenant-scoped Comments destination route. Inconsistent or foreign authority fails closed and no mutation or fake success is introduced.
